product_overview: CastMate is an Android application connecting actors and casting agencies, providing streamlined interaction through casting listings, profile management, and integrated AI tools to enhance actor training and agency support.
core_goals: Enable secure authentication for actors and agencies via email/password and Google Sign-In.
Provide efficient casting management including creation, application, and filtering functionalities.
Implement agenda features for scheduling and managing interviews for both actors and agencies.
Support user profile management tailored for actors and agencies.
Integrate AI-powered chatbot and training modules to enhance user experience.
Offer an intuitive navigation system with role-specific interfaces for actors and agencies.
Facilitate media uploads and interactive map features for casting localization.
key_features: Authentication system with email/password and Google Sign-In, leveraging JWT tokens stored securely.
Actor home screen displaying casting lists with search and filtering capabilities.
Casting management for creation, detailed views, application handling, and agency-specific casting lists.
Agenda management with calendar views and interview scheduling features.
User profile management screens and settings for actors and agencies.
AI Chatbot for agencies using Gemini and Groq technologies.
AI training module designed to improve actors' skills.
Favorites feature for actors to save preferred castings.
Interactive map for locating castings geographically.
Password reset flow with email support.
Media upload functionality supporting photos, videos, and PDFs.
Navigation implemented via Jetpack Navigation Compose with role-based navigation bars.
Robust API client configuration with Retrofit and secure interceptors.
user_flow_summary: User authenticates using email/password or Google Sign-In; JWT token is managed securely for session management.
Actors navigate through their home screen featuring casting listings, can apply to castings, and manage their candidatures and favorites.
Agencies manage their castings, create new listings, schedule interviews via agenda, and interact with the AI chatbot for support.
Users can update their profiles and settings depending on their role (actor or agency).
Actors engage with AI training tools to enhance their acting skills within the app.
Users can reset passwords through email validation flows.
Both actors and agencies use interactive maps to locate castings geographically.
Media uploads are integrated into casting creation and profile management workflows.
validation_criteria: Successful secure user authentication via both email/password and Google Sign-In.
Correct display and filtering of casting listings on actor home and agency casting screens.
Proper functioning of casting creation, detail viewing, and application submission features.
Accurate synchronization and display of agenda items and interview scheduling.
Full CRUD operations possible on user and agency profiles and settings.
Responsive and context-aware AI chatbot interaction for agencies.
Effective training session initiation and feedback within the AI training module.
Persistent storage and retrieval of favorites for actors.
Functional interactive map showing accurate casting locations.
Reliable password reset via email mechanism.
Smooth upload and integration of various media types without data loss.
Robust navigation with clear role-based paths and error-free API communication through Retrofit client.
